# Test text font

`Tuffy.ttf` is copied from the `fontdb` 0.23.0 test fixtures. Its copyright
holders released it to the public domain; the original notice is in
[`LICENSE.txt`](LICENSE.txt). SHA-256:
`b97cd5005278b24aabb69b8b6ead98860955599558f6e8119483b575a5fdce98`.

The font is used only by PDF tests and the print example. Library callers
supply their own licensed TrueType or OpenType text font.
